text.text_excerpt: This place has a great beer selection. I find that most bars or pubs have too few options and all the same basic Abita and NOLA and urban south options. This place though, they had a range of locals and crafts. Even better? The bar tender didn't just suggest light beer for me (I'm a woman so that tends to happen). With his help I found a lovely dark ale that was rich and delicious and new! The fries are also amazing, so crispy and crunchy with great herbs-- definitely get them with your drinks!

This is one of my favorite neighborhood go-tos. The large patio is great for al fresco dining and watching sports and the inside is small but has nice seating options. Service is at the bar, and it's usually staffed well. I've had only one not great experience getting prompt service. The drinks are a bit spendy, but they are well crafted (along with Barrel Proof, this is a fave spot of mine for Hemingway Daiquiris) and they have a nice selection of beer on tap and in cans. Sunday's special is $5 Bloody Marys and Mimosas. The food is also steeply priced, but everything I've had has been delicious. The debris fries are aces with an nice helping of cracked black pepper. Other good dishes I'v...

I really enjoy this place! There are a few tables inside and outdoor seating. They offer a small menu for food and have a great beer selection. They are connected to a wine bar so when we have a group its easy for everyone to find what they like to drink. The wings and brussel sprouts are damn tasty. They offer this breakfast type dish...unfortunately not a fan of that one. There is metered parking out front. Nice spot for two or a group.
